newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Geahin plans 4-for-5 bonus issue, rights.
newsitem.headline: Geahin plans 4-for-5 bonus issue, rights.

text.p: Malaysian civil and structural engineering firm Geahin Engineering Bhd said it was proposing a four-for-five bonus issue, along with a rights issue and several other proposals.
The bonus issue would comprise 16 million new shares, while the two-for-five rights issue would amount to another eight million new shares, the company said in a statement received on Tuesday.
The rights issue will be priced at 5.10 ringgit a share.
Geahin also proposed a two-for-five rights issue of a five-year, 5.0 percent irredeemable convertible unsecured loan stock (ICULS).
Another plan was the issue of 13.91 million new shares to Bumiputra (ethnic Malay) shareholders at 5.10 ringgit a share.
The company also announced planned acquisitions of eight engineering-related firms which will be paid by the issue of new Geahin shares.
Geahin's major shareholders will see their shareholding reduced to 28.52 percent from 51.95 percent after the proposed acquisitions and before the special share issue, the statement said.

Proceeds of 211.72 million ringgit to be raised from the rights, ICULS and special issues would be mainly used to retire or refinance bank borrowings (100 million ringgit), and for injection of equity capital (100 million ringgit).
